intent: One slide of a Carousel, taking the full length of the viewport along the scroll axis.
typical_uses: One card, image or panel in a Carousel's track

dont_use_when.situation: One entry of a plain list or grid that does not step or scroll

invariants.text: Every slide renders `role="group"` with `aria-roledescription="slide"`; a consumer `aria-label` (for example "2 of 5") lands on that group.

A slide pads only its leading edge along the scroll axis (inline start when horizontal, block start when vertical), which produces the gap between slides; its trailing and cross-axis edges carry no padding, so a bordered child placed directly inside sits flush against the viewport's clipped edge.

anti_patterns.dont: Place a bordered element (a Card, a framed image) directly inside CarouselItem
anti_patterns.do_instead: Wrap it in a padding element (`var(--space-1)` is enough) inside the slide, so its outline or shadow is not clipped by the viewport

a11y.by: carousel.test.tsx asserts role="group" and aria-roledescription="slide" on a CarouselItem

good.title: A bordered card inside a padded slide

bad.title: A slide placed straight in the Carousel root
bad.why: Slides belong inside CarouselContent, the track the engine measures and moves; outside it a slide is never scrolled.
